q: Where can I take golf lessons in Newmarket?
a: At The Bogey Club, 17705 Leslie Street, Unit 5, in Newmarket, Ontario. Private lessons are one-on-one with Andrew McDonald, Associate Professional with the PGA of Canada, on our indoor Golfzon simulators. We're a short drive from Aurora and East Gwillimbury.

q: Are private golf lessons good for beginners?
a: Yes. Andrew has taught golf at every level for more than eight years, from players picking up a club for the first time to advanced golfers chasing a lower handicap. Every lesson is built around your goals.

q: What will I work on in a golf lesson?
a: Andrew's personalized lessons focus on technique, strategy and the mental game: your grip, setup and swing, smarter club choice and course management, and the routines that hold up under pressure.

q: Why take golf lessons on a simulator?
a: Our Golfzon simulators measure every shot, including ball speed, launch angle, spin and carry, so you and your coach see exactly what the ball did. Lessons are indoors, so you can keep improving all year, rain or shine.

q: How much do private golf lessons cost?
a: Call the club at (905) 235-4653 or email Andrew at amcdonald@magnagolf.com for current lesson rates.

q: How do I book a golf lesson?
a: Call (905) 235-4653 or email Andrew at amcdonald@magnagolf.com and let him know what part of your game you want to work on.
